title: Leaflet In Russian Denouncing Alleged Communist Agents

page_data.en:
42-3
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Section 1, Special Branch    L Station/17851
REPORT
Date March 30, 1937
Subject Leaflet in Russian denouncing alleged communist agents.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by Iboyne D S I
Attached herewith together with translation is a
leaflet in Russian copies of which were circulated among the Rus-
sian community recently by post. The leaflet purports to have ema-
nated from the "League for Combating Communism" and contains names
and addresses of 15 Russians in Shanghai who are alleged to be
connected with the G.P.U.
G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 30 MAR 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
D.C. (special branch).
FILE
266
213

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号............
特务科第1组    L巡捕房/17851
报告
日期：1937年3月30日
事由：谴责所谓共产党代理人的俄文传单。
由警探长普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）制作。    由警探长伊博因（Iboyne）转呈
随函附上近期通过邮政在俄侨社区中流传的俄文传单及其译文。该传单声称出自“反共联盟”，其中列有15名在上海的俄国人的姓名和地址，指称他们与格别乌（G.P.U.）有关联。
G. 普罗科菲耶夫
警探长
（印：特务科 1937年3月30日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
副督察（特务科）。
